body_markdown:
[Back to All](https://docs.castle.io/changelog)


Added


Castle now gives you a single place to see how up to date your SDK integrations are.


Every SDK release adds new device and behavioral signals that our detection models use. Run the latest version to stay fully protected as attackers change their tools. The SDKs page makes it easy to spot which of your endpoints need an upgrade.


The new SDKs page shows which versions of the Browser, iOS, and Android SDKs your traffic is running on, alongside the latest available releases. You can also see a breakdown of traffic by version, including the volume and age of each version.


When a newer version is available, we’ll notify you and give you everything you need to upgrade.


You’ll find the page under User menu →[SDKs](https://dashboard.castle.io/developer/sdks) .
